# XHelpers Pro 1.0.2
**Added** - **Custom Quadrants** — Adjust the shared left/right split and each column's top/bottom split. The four regions always cover the usable screen without gaps or overlaps. - **Reposition Quadrant Windows** — Move currently registered quadrant windows into their newly configured regions directly from the quadrant editor.
**Improved** - **Window Focus** — Half-focus shortcuts now target only half-screen windows, even when an extreme custom quadrant falls within the normal registration margin. - **Shortcuts** — Quadrant actions are grouped more clearly, the quadrant editor is easier to find, and the Shortcuts dialog now opens at the top and accepts scrolling immediately. - **Permissions** — Access states that need attention now use an orange warning color for easier scanning.
